entries.title: Job 31:1
segments: I made a covenant with mine eyes; How then should I look upon a virgin?

entries.title: Job 31:2
segments: For what is the portion from God above, And the heritage from the Almighty on high?

entries.title: Job 31:3
segments: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, And disaster to the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Job 31:4
segments: Doth not he see my ways, And number all my steps?

entries.title: Job 31:5
segments: If I have walked with falsehood, And my foot hath hasted to deceit

entries.title: Job 31:6
segments: (Let me be weighed in an even balance, That God may know mine integrity);

entries.title: Job 31:7
segments: If my step hath turned out of the way, And my heart walked after mine eyes, And if any spot hath cleaved to my hands:

entries.title: Job 31:8
segments: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

entries.title: Job 31:9
segments: If my heart hath been enticed unto a woman, And I have laid wait at my neighbor's door;

entries.title: Job 31:10
segments: Then let my wife grind unto another, And let others bow down upon her.

entries.title: Job 31:11
segments: For that were a heinous crime; Yea, it were an iniquity to be punished by the judges:

entries.title: Job 31:12
segments: For it is a fire that consumeth unto Destruction, And would root out all mine increase.

entries.title: Job 31:13
segments: If I have despised the cause of my man-servant or of my maid-servant, When they contended with me;

entries.title: Job 31:14
segments: What then shall I do when God riseth up? And when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

entries.title: Job 31:15
segments: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? And did not one fashion us in the womb?

entries.title: Job 31:16
segments: If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

entries.title: Job 31:17
segments: Or have eaten my morsel alone, And the fatherless hath not eaten thereof

entries.title: Job 31:18
segments: (Nay, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father,  And her have I guided from my mother's womb);

entries.title: Job 31:19
segments: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, Or that the needy had no covering;

entries.title: Job 31:20
segments: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he hath not been warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

entries.title: Job 31:21
segments: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, Because I saw my help in the gate:

entries.title: Job 31:22
segments: Then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, And mine arm be broken from the bone.

entries.title: Job 31:23
segments: For calamity from God is a terror to me, And by reason of his majesty I can do nothing.

entries.title: Job 31:24
segments: If I have made gold my hope, And have said to the fine gold, [Thou art] my confidence;

entries.title: Job 31:25
segments: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because my hand had gotten much;

entries.title: Job 31:26
segments: If I have beheld the sun when it shined, Or the moon walking in brightness,

entries.title: Job 31:27
segments: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, And my mouth hath kissed my hand:

entries.title: Job 31:28
segments: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judges; For I should have denied the God that is above.

entries.title: Job 31:29
segments: If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, Or lifted up myself when evil found him;

entries.title: Job 31:30
segments: (Yea, I have not suffered by mouth to sin By asking his life with a curse);

entries.title: Job 31:31
segments: If the men of my tent have not said, Who can find one that hath not been filled with his meat?

entries.title: Job 31:32
segments: (The sojourner hath not lodged in the street; But I have opened my doors to the traveller);

entries.title: Job 31:33
segments: If like Adam I have covered my transgressions, By hiding mine iniquity in my bosom,

entries.title: Job 31:34
segments: Because I feared the great multitude, And the contempt of families terrified me, So that I kept silence, and went not out of the door-

entries.title: Job 31:35
segments: Oh that I had one to hear me! (Lo, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me); And [that I had] the indictment which mine adversary hath written!

entries.title: Job 31:36
segments: Surely I would carry it upon my shoulder; I would bind it unto me as a crown:

entries.title: Job 31:37
segments: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; As a prince would I go near unto him.

entries.title: Job 31:38
segments: If my land crieth out against me, And the furrows thereof weep together;

entries.title: Job 31:39
segments: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, Or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

entries.title: Job 31:40
segments: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, And cockle instead of barley.  The words of Job are ended.
